latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Demo Clip Maker — AI-powered video demo creation and export.

- Upload raw footage up to 500MB (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM) for processing into polished demo clips.
- Cloud GPU backend generates 1080p MP4 demo clips from your recordings in 1–2 minutes.
- Automatic setup: free token generation and session management.
- Supports export, credits check, timeline preview, and edit actions via user prompts.
- Clear error handling with user guidance for common issues (credits, formats, file size).
- Multiple common workflows supported: quick edits, batch processing, and iterative refinement.
